answers.workaround:
Users currently cannot work around the multi-threading bugs in the soft body APIs or the lack of ability to control constraints.
Users could work around the normal shading problems by directly using `PhysicsServer3D` instead of `SoftBody3D`, and ignoring the normals returned by the physics server and computing normals on their own instead.  That said, this seems rather inconvenient.

title: Improvements to PhysicsServer3D soft body APIs
